Do NOT accept these claims as reported -- independently re-derive at least the core ones yourself: (1) diff test/fixtures/simulation/differential_corpus.json against the real R-Co source at c:/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/R-Co/tests/differential/corpus/conditions_v1.json yourself and confirm byte-for-byte parity (or find a real discrepancy); (2) run mix test test/letflow/engine/expr_differential_corpus_test.exs yourself and confirm the reported pass/count assertions; (3) check the test is self-sufficient (no shared mutable state, no hardcoded secrets, no execution-order dependency) per the standard Step 3b checklist. result.summary: Independently re-derived all core claims rather than accepting TEST-DESIGNER's report; all pass. (1) Fixture parity: ran `diff --strip-trailing-cr test/fixtures/simulation/differential_corpus.json c:/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/R-Co/tests/differential/corpus/conditions_v1.json` myself -- exit code 0, zero output, zero differences. Both files are 170 lines. Spot-read the first fixture entry (gw-001, condition_id/source_definition_id/source_definition_version/source_gateway_node_id/condition_text/context/expected_result all present) and confirmed structural shape matches AC1's required fields. (2) mix test: ran `mix test test/letflow/engine/expr_differential_corpus_test.exs` myself (default seed 378065) and again with `--seed 1` for order-independence -- both runs: 'Result: 1 passed', 0 failures, matching TEST-DESIGNER's reported count exactly. Also ran `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` myself -- clean exit, no warnings, matching AC6. (3) Self-sufficiency: (a) every acceptance criterion has runnable coverage -- see per-AC re-check below, no @tag :skip anywhere in the file; (b) no 'TODO: implement test' string in spec or test file (grepped, none found); (c) no shared hardcoded/mutable state -- grepped for Application.put_env/:ets/Agent/GenServer/:persistent_term, none present; the only module-level state is @corpus and @expected_unsupported_ids, both compile-time-computed module attributes derived from a static file read, not runtime-shared mutable state; (d) self-sufficient/order-independent -- single test block, no setup/teardown, no dependency on prior test execution, confirmed by re-running with a different seed (--seed 1) and getting the same pass result; (e) grepped test file and fixture for secret/password/conn_str/postgres:\/\/ /amqp:\/\/ /api_key patterns -- zero matches. Every REQ-209 acceptance criterion re-checked directly against the actual test file (not TEST-DESIGNER's summary): AC1 confirmed via my own diff above plus the file's own `assert length(@corpus) == 15` (line 74). AC2 confirmed by direct inspection -- exactly one `test` block (line 73), one `Enum.reduce/3` loop (lines 76-109), calling `Expr.evaluate_condition/2` (line 83), no macro-generated per-entry tests. AC3 confirmed by inspection (two-branch case at lines 92-108, each branch incrementing exactly one counter) and by my own test run showing all three post-loop assertions pass (lines 111-113). AC4 confirmed by reading the moduledoc (lines 1-53) and independently verifying its citations are real: grepped lib/letflow/engine/expr.ex and found the literal 'AC11' section header (line 22, '## R-Co's `src/expr` is not a CEL implementation (AC11)') and EXP-102 references (lines 5, 24, 32) -- the moduledoc's citations are not fabricated. AC5 satisfied by construction and confirmed by my own passing test run showing zero divergence between actual and expected_result across all 15 entries; the No-Issue-Left-Local-Only trigger point (condition_id-labelled assert message, lines 94-95) was inspected and is real code that would fire on a genuine divergence -- none occurred. AC6 confirmed by my own `mix test` and `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` runs quoted above, both real output, both clean. No BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR issues found.
